Extract exact CSS for these specific Webflow pricing sections from /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css

For EACH selector below, return: every property/value, every responsive media query block (max-width 991/767/479 AND min-width 1280/1440), and the line number in the CSS file.

Selectors to pull:
1. .new-price-sec, .new-price-sec.pricing-page-newsc
2. .pricing-tabs-2, .pricing-tabs-2 .w-tab-link, .pricing-tabs-2 .w-tab-link.w--current, .pricing-tabs-menu-2
3. .pricing-grid.new
4. .pricing-card-2, .pricing-card-2.center-pcard
5. .h6-heading-5.plan-name (plan name pill)
6. .h3-heading-3 (price text)
7. .button-pricing
8. .pricing-badge, .pricing-badge-tab
9. .pricing-table-wrapper, .pricing-table-row, .pricing-table-cell, .pricing-table-cell.is-header
10. .blue-sec.pricing-blue-sec (custom plan CTA)
11. .roi-sec, #roi-calc
12. .feature-list, .feature-li, .feature-li-icon (in pricing card)
13. The hero h1 styles for pricing page (.h1-heading or whatever the pricing page hero uses)
14. .pricing-tabs-content (tab pane)
15. Any class containing "pricing-cta" or "pricing-card-cta"

Use grep to find each selector. Report each in a code block with the exact CSS values. Be exhaustive — do not paraphrase or simplify. Include hover states, transitions, transforms.

Also from /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/pricing.html lines 359-1170 extract:
- Exact HTML structure of one pricing card (Growth — the highlighted center one) including all child elements, classes, and text
- Exact HTML structure of the comparison table (one row example with all cells)
- Exact HTML of the Monthly/Quarterly/Annual tabs

Report under 800 words. Code blocks for CSS, HTML snippets verbatim.
